stats.source: GOB 309 has rank-scaled stat 1031 for viral damage and 1053 for cost. The direct percent cost stat 117 links to 1053. 309 also grants linked concentration 1090.
stats.runtime: AbilityPassives publishes the source records. AbilityStats.Influence feeds linked 1053 to ordinary ability admission and debit through AbilityCosts.Effective; the existing viral damage and interruptible-cast concentration consumers still read the passive.
stats.test: PR726 stock captures confirm rank-19 adds, unloads and reloads, and both exact paid-cost contrasts: Freeze 17 with 309+346 versus 18 with just 346; Evade 38 with 346 versus 40 with neither. HackerLoadedPassivesReachViralDamageAndCastThroughConsumers checks the other live effects and their removal. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/726#issuecomment-7073533731
